newsitem.title: USA: Ford Q1 North American exports up 15 pct.
newsitem.headline: Ford Q1 North American exports up 15 pct.

text.p: Ford Motor Co said Friday it shipped a record 37,045 vehicles from the United States and Canada to export markets during the first quarter, more than any other North American automaker.
Ford said its export total, which consisted of 13,505 cars and 23,540 trucks was up 15 percent over exports during the first quarter of 1996.

During the first quarter, Ford began exporting Taurus sedans built in Chicago to Russia; Ranger one-ton pickup trucks, built in Edison, N.J., to Latin America; and the Mercury Tracer, built in Wayne, Mich., to the Middle East.
Ford's top export model from North America in the first quarter was the Explorer sport utility vehicle, followed by Ranger pickup, the Windstar minivan and the Escort small car.
Ford said it now ships vehicles from North America to more than 120 countries.
